name: vscode-extension-vercel-ai
description: Use Vercel AI Gateway models in VS Code chat with your gateway API key or Vercel OIDC. Community extension, not made by Vercel.

vercelAiGateway.endpoint.description: AI Gateway endpoint URL. Change for self-hosted or regional deployments. Only read from user settings, since requests to it carry your credentials.

vercelAiGateway.timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the model to start or continue responding, and for the model list to load.

vercelAiGateway.disallowPromptTraining.description: Route chat requests only to providers that do not train on prompts. A model with no such provider fails with an error instead of falling back. Turning it on in user or workspace settings is enough; a workspace cannot turn it off. Not enforced for requests that use your own provider keys (BYOK).

vercelAiGateway.zeroDataRetention.description: Route chat requests only to providers with zero data retention agreements with Vercel. Needs a Vercel Pro or Enterprise team. A model with no such provider fails with an error instead of falling back. Turning it on in user or workspace settings is enough; a workspace cannot turn it off. Your own provider keys (BYOK) are skipped unless marked as ZDR in the AI Gateway dashboard.

enumDescriptions: Use the gateway's own provider ranking, based on recent uptime and latency.
Try the provider with the lowest estimated cost first.
Try the provider with the lowest median time to first token first.
Try the provider with the highest median tokens per second first.
vercelAiGateway.providerSort.description: Order in which the gateway tries the providers that serve a chat model. The gateway falls back through the rest in that order and tries unhealthy providers last; no provider is excluded.

vercelAiGateway.providerOrder.description: Provider slugs the gateway tries first for a chat model, in this order, such as bedrock or anthropic. The gateway falls back to the other providers afterwards, in its own ranking or the providerSort order; no provider is excluded.

vercelAiGateway.providerOnly.description: Provider slugs a chat request may use, such as anthropic. The gateway never falls back outside the list, so a model none of them serve fails. Only read from user settings.

vercelAiGateway.reportingTags.description: Tags recorded with each chat request in the gateway's usage reports, such as team:platform, so you can filter or group the extension's spend. The gateway bills each tag on a request as a reporting write. Up to 10 tags of 64 characters; others are dropped. Only read from user settings.

vercelAiGateway.reportingUser.description: User ID recorded with each chat request in the gateway's usage reports, such as your username, so a team sharing a key can split the extension's spend per person. The gateway bills it as a reporting write. Up to 256 characters; a longer value is not sent. Only read from user settings.

vercelAiGateway.fallbackModels.description: Model ids the gateway tries in this order when every provider of the chosen chat model fails, such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5. The answer and its cost then come from the fallback model. Only read from user settings.

enumDescriptions: Let the gateway run inference in any region, based on availability and latency.
Run inference and store any provider data in a US data center.
Run inference and store any provider data in an EU data center.
Run inference and store any provider data in an Australian data center.
Run inference and store any provider data in a Japanese data center.
vercelAiGateway.inferenceRegion.description: Region where the provider runs inference on chat requests and stores any data it keeps. A pinned region can cost more, and a model with no provider in that region fails with an error instead of running elsewhere. Only read from user settings.

vercelAiGateway.excludeQuantizations.description: Weight formats, such as fp8 or int4, that a provider must not serve a chat model in. The gateway skips providers that report a listed format and keeps those that report none; a model whose every provider is excluded fails with an error. Only read from user settings.

enumDescriptions: Output constrained to a JSON schema.

vercelAiGateway.requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the provider's model must have for the gateway to route a chat request to it. A model with no provider that has every listed capability fails with an error. Only read from user settings.

enumDescriptions: Use the provider's standard processing tier.
Ask for the lower cost tier, which can respond more slowly.
Ask for the faster, more available tier, which costs more.
vercelAiGateway.serviceTier.description: Processing tier the gateway asks for on chat requests. Only OpenAI, Google AI Studio, Google Vertex AI and SpaceXAI models offer tiers, and a provider may still serve the standard tier; the gateway bills the tier actually served. Only read from user settings.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm exec lefthook validate && pnpm knip && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm package
